description: Pathway schematic of the FabA/FabB oxygen-independent unsaturated fatty acid branch, showing the C10 branch point, FabB commitment, and FabF extension to cis-vaccenate
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 8.5))
ax.set_xlim(0, 13); ax.set_ylim(0, 10); ax.axis('off')

ax.text(6.5, 9.6, "The FabA/FabB oxygen-independent branch of bacterial FAS-II",
        ha='center', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(6.5, 9.15, "Double bond fixed at the C10 stage; geometry/position carried forward by elongation",
        ha='center', fontsize=10, style='italic', color='#444')

def box(x, y, w, h, text, fc, tc='black', fs=9, bold=False):
    b = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.05,rounding_size=0.12",
                       linewidth=1.3, edgecolor='#333', facecolor=fc)
    ax.add_patch(b)
    ax.text(x+w/2, y+h/2, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs,
            color=tc, fontweight='bold' if bold else 'normal')

def arrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, label='', enzyme='', color='#222', lw=2.2):
    a = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2), arrowstyle='-|>', mutation_scale=18,
                        linewidth=lw, color=color)
    ax.add_patch(a)
    if enzyme:
        ax.text((x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2+0.28, enzyme, ha='center', fontsize=9,
                fontweight='bold', color=color)
    if label:
        ax.text((x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2-0.30, label, ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#555')

sat = '#cfe2f3'; unsat = '#f9cb9c'; enz = '#d9ead3'

# Top row: shared saturated cycle up to C10
box(0.3, 7.6, 2.2, 0.9, "malonyl-ACP\n+ acyl-ACP", sat)
arrow(2.5, 8.05, 3.4, 8.05, enzyme='FabB/F/H')
box(3.4, 7.6, 2.3, 0.9, "3-oxoacyl-ACP", sat)
arrow(5.7, 8.05, 6.6, 8.05, enzyme='FabG')
box(6.6, 7.6, 3.0, 0.9, "(3R)-hydroxy-\ndecanoyl-ACP  (C10)", sat, bold=True)

# Down to FabA step 1
arrow(8.1, 7.6, 8.1, 6.5, enzyme='FabA  (step 1)', label='dehydration', color='#b45f06')
box(6.6, 5.6, 3.0, 0.9, "trans-2-decenoyl-ACP", '#ffe599', bold=True)

# Branch: either FabA isomerization (unsat) OR FabI reduction (sat)
arrow(6.6, 6.05, 4.6, 6.05, enzyme='FabA (step 2)', label='cis/trans isomerization', color='#b45f06')
box(1.9, 5.6, 2.7, 0.9, "cis-3-decenoyl-ACP", unsat, bold=True)

arrow(9.6, 6.05, 11.2, 6.05, enzyme='FabI', color='#3d85c6')
box(11.0, 5.6, 1.8, 0.9, "saturated\nelongation", sat)
ax.text(11.9, 5.35, "(shared FAS-II)", ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#3d85c6')

# FabB commitment
arrow(3.25, 5.6, 3.25, 4.55, enzyme='FabB (KAS I)', label='commitment: + malonyl-ACP, condensation', color='#cc0000')
box(1.5, 3.55, 3.5, 0.9, "3-oxo-cis-5-dodecenoyl-ACP\n(double bond committed)", unsat, bold=True)

# elongation to 16:1
arrow(3.25, 3.55, 3.25, 2.7, enzyme='FabG/FabZ/FabI x2 rounds', color='#674ea7')
box(1.7, 1.8, 3.1, 0.9, "palmitoleoyl-ACP\n16:1 Δ⁹", unsat, bold=True)

# FabF extension to 18:1
arrow(4.8, 2.25, 7.4, 2.25, enzyme='FabF (KAS II)', label='+ malonyl-ACP; thermal/piezo-regulated', color='#38761d')
box(7.4, 1.8, 3.2, 0.9, "cis-vaccenoyl-ACP\n18:1 Δ¹¹", unsat, bold=True)

# to membrane
arrow(9.0, 1.8, 9.0, 1.0, enzyme='PlsB/PlsC')
box(7.6, 0.15, 2.8, 0.8, "membrane phospholipids", '#ead1dc')

# legend
handles = [mpatches.Patch(color=sat, label='shared saturated / FAS-II'),
           mpatches.Patch(color=unsat, label='committed unsaturated branch'),
           mpatches.Patch(color='#ffe599', label='branch-point intermediate')]
ax.legend(handles=handles, loc='lower left', fontsize=8, frameon=True)

# obligatory-core annotation
ax.text(0.35, 4.9, "OBLIGATORY CORE:\nFabA → FabB", fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
        color='#cc0000', va='center',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='#fff2cc', ec='#cc0000'))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('fabA_fabB_pathway_schematic.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Saved schematic. Pathway: C10 hydroxy-ACP -> (FabA dehydr) trans-2 -> (FabA isom) cis-3 -> (FabB commit) -> 16:1 -> (FabF) 18:1")
